artifacts.content:
All 4 tests pass (`node --test`: 4 pass, 0 fail).

The bug spanned two modules:

1. **`lib/cart.mjs`** — `cartTotal` summed only `item.price`, ignoring quantity. Fixed to `sum + item.price * item.qty`.
2. **`lib/discount.mjs`** — `applyDiscount` subtracted `percent` as a flat amount instead of a percentage. Fixed to `total - (total * percent) / 100`.

`lib/pricing.mjs` was already correct. (I also cleaned up a stray scratch file I created earlier in `.agent-replay/`.)
